scope: Native Q2 only, retained preparation/compile-preflight-supported functions; all declared source-expression input/autotune Cartesian tuples for these functions

plan.completion: All manifest entries; resumable. No fixed wall-clock truncation.
plan.counting: Declared unique source-expression input and autotune Cartesian tuples; branch-inactive choices may share JIT compilations. All original source pruning retained.

limitations: Observed dependencies for the retained Q2 scope, not the complete Q2/CI requirement set.
Usable JIT captures from entries with another failing JIT remain counted. Missing/failed capture is unknown coverage, not feature absence.
Same native compiler input is deduplicated globally for static sites and once per configuration for configuration-weighted sites; neither is a runtime invocation count.
C310 definition availability is not final device linking, bridge/PTODSL support or runtime validation.
Local historical template patches are included. Not an untouched-upstream audit.
Differences from the older mixed-suite census cannot be attributed to Triton 3.6 alone.
